meta.title: A surrogate bid is refused on an offline-trading event
gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The available setup recipes and operations do not create or configure an offline-trading stage.
it depends on a company setting this run does not change (offline trading) — a failure is reported as couldn't tell, not as a bug

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer enters a surrogate bid with no price on the vendor's behalf for the invited QA vendor.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).

plan.title: A surrogate bid is refused on an offline-trading event

assert.say: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing)
